“Now the thing is, how do you manage that situation with a Cristiano, knowing that part of the development process Ole was putting in place was this, legs, running, high pressure, this type of thing.

“Whether you agree or disagree with having a Ronaldo in your team or not, somebody has to make that decision. There is a moment when a player has to realise you're part of something, you're not just the something.
